comparison.objective: Collect an anterior nasal specimen with prescribed circles in both nostrils and recap the swab.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine force-controlled tool circling in a confined compliant opening, depth control, and recapping.
comparison.success_condition: Four valid circles per nostril at 0.3–2 N and specified depth, capped and released for 1 s; contamination and over-depth failures are explicit.
comparison.reason: Tests delicate contact tracing and contamination avoidance, not many-body separation.
